name: Harmonic Picks
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Choose a deck and find USB tracks with compatible keys and pitch changes within 6% of its live BPM.
description: Emulator preview 0.2.0; physical testing pending. Open Mod Menu > Harmonic Picks. Tap Match deck 1-4 (choose your MASTER manually). Lists up to 40 compatible library keys within +/-6% pitch of the selected deck live BPM. Shows signed pitch, half/double time and USB number. Tap All tracks/Acapellas to filter; Previous/Next or knob to scroll; knob press changes filter. Suggestions only; no auto-loading. Live key changes are not tracked. Reload mods after changing USB libraries. Uses SDK services; no hooks or audio changes.
